# KaizenReply

> **Your message is good. Make it better.** — Free, open-source AI message refiner, reply generator, and **Reality vs LinkedIn meme generator** built on Japanese Kaizen (改善) principles, with no login or paywall.

## Why KaizenReply Is Unique
Most writing tools either fix only punctuation or rewrite your message until it sounds robotic. KaizenReply applies the Japanese philosophy of **Kaizen (改善 — continuous improvement)** and the **5S framework** (*Seiri* sort/cut fluff, *Seiton* structure, *Seiso* polish tone, *Seiketsu* keep your voice consistent, *Shitsuke* learn from edits):
- **Don't rewrite. Improve.** — Preserves your facts, intent, and personal voice.
- **Transparent Marginalia & Score** — Shows a 0–100 before/after score across Clarity, Tone, Professionalism, and Readability, plus line-by-line reasons for every change.
- **100% Free Reality vs LinkedIn Meme Generator** — No watermark, no account, and no paywall (unlike paid LinkedIn meme tools).

## Key Features
- **Free Reality vs LinkedIn Meme Generator**: Type any ordinary event (e.g., "I ate a sandwich at 2 PM because I forgot lunch"), select **LinkedIn Bro**, click **Refine Draft**, and click **Meme Card** to download or share a 2048×1364 comparison image.
- **21 Tone Presets & 9 Platforms**: From Professional, Diplomatic, and Formal to LinkedIn Bro, Cold Email Hook, and Roast My Draft — tailored to Email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, X (Twitter), SMS, Slack, Discord, Instagram, and Telegram.
- **Reply Mode**: Generates 3 distinct, ready-to-send replies to any incoming message.
- **100+ Kotowaza Proverbs**: Traditional Japanese wisdom bundled offline.
